messages:
alex: Heads-up — PR #12890 (db migration) needs to land before the maintenance blackout tomorrow 03:00 UTC. CI is currently red on macos-unit. Can someone help rerun the flaky job or give guidance on a rebase window? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

maria: @alex what's the approval state? do we have required reviews approved?

jamal: I was the last reviewer, I left one small comment about the migration idempotency. If that's addressed I'm happy to approve.

alex: addressed the idempotency comment in the last commit (fixed ordering). pushed at 2469999800. pinging @jamal for final sign-off.

jamal: taking a quick look now. if tests are green i'll approve.

alex: @ci-bot can you rerun macos-unit for PR 12890? flaky failure was `TestSchemaRoundtrip` earlier.

ci-bot: Rerun requested by alex. Triggering job macos-unit (attempt 2) for PR 12890...

releasebot: Note — there is a short rebase window from 02:00–02:30 UTC for infra migrations. Anything landing outside that window risks being delayed until post-blackout.

katy: I can babysit the job during the rerun and will post here when it's green.

sre-oncall: FYI, deploy freeze starts 02:45 UTC. If this can't be merged before 02:30 we should hold and land after maintenance. We don't want partial schema changes in the middle of the blackout.

jamal: macos-unit passed on rerun. approving now. :white_check_mark:

jamal: approved.

alex: thanks @jamal. @katy please confirm the rest of CI (linux/integration) is clean before merge. if green i'll request merge slot.

katy: linux/integration green. all checks passed at 2470001300.

alex: requesting manual merge — can someone with merge privileges take this or allow admin merge? we need to land before 02:30 UTC.

releasebot: Merge queue check: current backlog small, can accept one hot merge. Please ensure migration feature-flag is off by default.

alex: feature-flag off by default in config — double checked.

sre-oncall: go ahead, but hold if anything spikes. i'll monitor infra and rollback plan is ready.

jamal: merged via web UI at 2470001375. thanks everyone for the quick turn. :rocket:

alex: great work — will follow up with a short post-merge smoke run and confirm DB state.
